limits: Only the Ambilight ARCHITECTURE.md changed between the two installations; runtime files are byte-identical.
36 runtime and 13 type mode groups are core/chapter consumers, not whole-ecosystem consumer acceptance.
Nine-color Canvas palette is painted through the public post-processing callback, not inferred from natural video frames.
Physical mobile devices, full package distribution, Canvas Document PiP/subtitle combinations and remote CI remain open.
